Key Takeaways
A revised keyword strategy was proposed, shifting from broad terminologies to specific, transactional, long-tail keywords aimed at boosting conversion rates.
The updated document comparing old versus new keyword approaches is to be shared, and the ecommerce link must be added to the tracking sheet as per Shiresha's request.
A dedicated landing page for ecommerce web development services was discussed, focusing on technical keywords (e.g., PHP, Shopify, WooCommerce) to improve lead generation.
A structured timeline for adding blog images and publishing content was requested to ensure consistent updates without delays.
Google Ads and GA4 tracking improvements were emphasized, with a commitment to share detailed reports via email and provide weekly analysis every Friday.

Objective
Share and review the document outlining old versus new keyword strategies to support the new approach.
Plan to optimize ecommerce pages by shifting from broad keywords to service-specific clusters to improve organic ranking and drive higher conversion rates.
Develop dedicated landing pages for ecommerce consulting, API integration, and web development services to offer cohesive and targeted solutions.
Establish a timeline for blog content and image acquisition to ensure regular publishing and consistent traffic generation.
Prepare and deliver the monthly SEO and marketing performance report by Friday for October.
Target Audience
Target technical users of ecommerce platforms like Shopify and Magento who seek specific, service-based solutions.
Focus on capturing high-intent, transactional searchers with a preference for solutions such as ecommerce consulting and API integration.
Messaging & Positioning
Shift messaging from broad generic keywords to more specific, service-oriented keywords to clearly define value propositions.
Clarify the differentiation between API development and API integration to avoid confusion in product engineering services.
Channels
Utilize organic SEO strategies via Google and emerging AI platforms to enhance visibility and capture long-tail transactional searches.
Deploy Google Ads campaigns with analysis to be shared by email with designated stakeholders.
Publish content through blogs on Length Foundry and Sigma, ensuring proper images and scheduled releases.
Timeline
Google Ads report to be reviewed and shared today via email.
Establish and adhere to a three-month timeline for publishing blog blocks with accompanying images.
Ship ecommerce API related content by this weekend to maintain project momentum.
Deliver the consolidated monthly SEO report for October by Friday after complete data is received.
Budget
Metrics
Evaluate keyword volume alongside transactional search and conversion metrics to measure campaign success.
Monitor GA4 form fill events and overall conversion trends through regular monthly performance reports.
Creative Requirements
Develop a block calendar outlining timelines for image and content updates to avoid publishing delays.
Ensure blog posts include proper images by integrating image delivery with content creation.
Dependencies
Keyword strategy depends on the document detailing the old versus new approach, to be shared by Revanth.
Implementation of web development service pages requires coordination with Magesh and internal technical teams.
Timely blog image delivery is critical for maintaining the publishing schedule and overall content rollout.
Risk
Failure to update API development versus integration keywords could negatively impact SEO performance and clarity of service offering.
Delayed acquisition of blog images may postpone content publication and slow down traffic generation.

Doc compares old broad keywords vs new specific service clusters for ecommerce pages.
Targeting transactional, long-tail keywords in specific solution clusters to boost conversion and SEO visibility.
